grants.blurb: Support for Six Points, helping cover un-reimbursed medical and travel expenses for seniors who need extra assistance. This funding ensures that essential care and necessary appointments remain accessible for those with limited means.
Funding dedicated to food assistance programs for seniors, helping ensure that community members in need have consistent access to nutritious meals throughout the year.
Support for the Gunnison Valley Animal Welfare League (GVAWL), helping cover adoption fees so seniors can welcome a companion animal into their homes—providing comfort, joy, and companionship.
Support for the Gunnison Seniors to help reduce their energy costs and make their homes safe, livable, and affordable.

Funding to help create a dedicated senior wing at the Ann Zugelder Gunnison Library, offering a welcoming space for reading, learning, and community programs specifically geared toward older residents.

Ongoing support for upkeep and maintenance of the Original Health Care Center, a facility built and historically managed by the Gunnison Home Association to serve the needs of the community’s seniors.

Long-term investment in Assisted Living, including the original construction funded by GHA. Recent grants supported the replacement of the fire suppression system and also provide seniors with a monthly meal out, offering both safety and community connection.

A donation to Gunnison Valley Health to fund the installation of a modern sprinkler system at The Willows Assisted Living Center, helping ensure a safe, secure, and well protected living environment for its residents.
Funding provided to the Gunnison Arts Center for the installation of an accessible ramp, improving mobility and ensuring all visitors can comfortably enjoy community arts programs.
Grant supporting the addition of an accessible ramp and a golf cart for transportation at the Pioneer Museum, enhancing accessibility for seniors and visitors with mobility challenges.

Grant awarded to the American Legion for the construction of an accessible outdoor patio and installation of an accessible ramp. Creating a welcoming, inclusive gathering space for members and the greater community.
Funding to the Willows, dedicated to providing seniors with a monthly meal out. Giving residents an opportunity to socialize, dine together, and enjoy time out in the community.
Donation for Mountain Roots to support providing nutritious produce across the Gunnison valley and western Colorado. From free boxes of produce to creating community in their gardens.
